newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - March 24.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - March 24.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones dropped 15.49 points to 6,804.79. PLDT's ADR rose $1 1/4 to $59 1/8.
* The peso closed lower at 26.344 to the dollar vs 26.333
* The Philippine Stock Exchange composite index slid 5.02 points to 3,201.65.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average was unchanged at 10.03125 percent.
